parameters.content:
## DEPLOYED — live in n8n since 2026-07-31
Implements household-ledger-architecture.md §7 (bulk-trip economics) — the 4th of the 5 planned agents. No schema extension needed: `Stores` and `Inventory.cycle_count` are already in household-ledger-sheets-schema.md.

STATUS: real `documentId`, chat ID, Google Sheets credential, and Telegram bot credential all wired; workflow published.

WHY THIS CAN'T PRODUCE REAL OUTPUT YET, EVEN THOUGH DEPLOYED: it needs real `Stores.distance_from_home_mi`/`est_trip_cost` data (Open Decision #5, resolved 2026-08-01 as auto-geocoding — not yet wired into this workflow, see the 'Geocode Store Distance' node below) and real `Inventory.avg_days_to_finish`/`cycle_count` history, which only accumulates once the Check-In Agent has actually been running for multiple purchase cycles. That's expected — dependencies just haven't accumulated yet.

V1 SIMPLIFICATION, FLAGGED HONESTLY: architecture.md says trip cost should be 'amortized if the bulk buy covers several months of supply' — true multi-item trip-bundling (combining several items' savings to justify one trip) is a harder optimization problem than this scaffold solves. V1 rule: recommend only if a SINGLE item's own annual savings already exceeds one round trip's cost on its own — conservative (will under-recommend relative to true trip-bundling economics), but won't give a false-positive recommendation.

The 'show as a badge in the app next to that item' idea in architecture.md §7 step 4 is a src/App.jsx frontend change — not touched here, flagged as a separate follow-on task.

nodes.name: Weekly Recommendation Trigger
nodes.notes: Weekly, per architecture.md §7 ('weekly or monthly is plenty, this doesn't need daily'). Change daysInterval to 30 for monthly if preferred.

nodes.name: Get Settings for Home Address
nodes.notes: First step of the auto-geocoding chain (Open Decision #5, resolved 2026-08-01). Chained sequentially rather than run in parallel-then-merge, applying the exact lesson from today's Merge List + Settings bug in the List/Budget Webhook Agent: a named-node reference ($('Get Settings for Home Address')) is only safe once this node has actually finished, and a straight chain guarantees that without needing a Merge node at all.

nodes.name: Get Stores for Geocoding
nodes.notes: Separate read from the 'Get Stores' node further down (which the recommendation math uses) — this one runs first and drives the geocoding pass so that later read picks up freshly-updated distances in the same execution.

nodes.name: Missing Distance?
nodes.notes: Only geocodes rows that don't already have a distance AND only if Settings.home_address has actually been filled in (it's blank by default — a real address is personal information and deliberately never committed to this repo, see household-ledger-sheets-schema.md). No home address set = this whole branch is a no-op and Stores stays exactly as manually entered, same behavior as before this feature existed.

parameters.url: =https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/distancematrix/json?origins={{ encodeURIComponent($('Get Settings for Home Address').first().json.home_address) }}&destinations={{ encodeURIComponent($json.address) }}&units=imperial

nodes.name: Geocode Store Distance

httpQueryAuth.name: Google Maps Distance Matrix API Key (Household Ledger)

nodes.notes: httpQueryAuth credential should hold the query param name 'key' and your Google Maps Platform API key as its value (Distance Matrix API takes the key as a URL param, not a header). Explicit Accept header added preemptively — applying the same fix Brave Search needed in the Price Refresh Agent (n8n's default multi-type Accept header 422s some APIs) rather than waiting to hit it live here too. Requires the Distance Matrix API enabled on that Google Cloud project; billing must be active (Google requires it even within the free monthly credit).

nodes.name: Geocode Succeeded?
nodes.notes: A non-OK Distance Matrix status (e.g. NOT_FOUND for a bad address, ZERO_RESULTS) skips the sheet write rather than clobbering the row with blanks — that store's distance just stays empty for this run, same as if geocoding hadn't run at all.

nodes.name: Geocoding Done
nodes.notes: Barrier node: every Stores row has either been geocoded+updated, already had a distance, or was skipped (no home address / geocode failure) by the time execution reaches here — only then do the three reads below (which the recommendation math depends on) fire, so they always see this run's fresh distances instead of racing the geocoding pass.

nodes.name: Merge Catalog + Stores + Inventory
nodes.notes: Same join pattern as the existing Webhook Agent's 'Merge List + Settings' node.
